targets.rawSql:
-- Panel query (Device → Room for Stat)
WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb AS (
  SELECT
    dp.position          AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno        AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset        AS parent_pos,
    0                    AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno] AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,
    p.parentasset,
    c.depth + 1,
    c.visited || p.equipmentno
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno = ANY (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no,
    c.depth
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
listed AS (
  SELECT
    room.equipmentno AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    CONCAT(parts.part1_txt, '/', parts.part2_txt, '-', parts.part3_txt) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    room.equipmentdesc       AS ConferenceRoom,
    d.equipmentno            AS EquipmentNo
  FROM eam_devices d
  JOIN pos_to_room pr     ON pr.start_pos     = d.position
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no

  -- natural-sort split for room code
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  ) AS parts
)
SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt AS "Room"
FROM listed
WHERE EquipmentNo IN (${device:sqlstring})
LIMIT 1;

targets.query:
SELECT mean("rtt_ms") AS "RTT (ms)"
FROM "ping_check"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "equipmentno" = '$device'
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null);

SELECT last("status") AS "status"
FROM "ping_check"
WHERE "equipmentno" = '$device' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

SELECT last("status") AS "Last snmp"
FROM "snmp_probe"
WHERE "equipmentno" = '$device' AND $timeFilter

SELECT mean("status") * 100 AS "availability_%"
FROM "ping_check"
WHERE "equipmentno" = '$device' AND $timeFilter

SELECT percentile("rtt_ms", 95) AS "p95 RTT (ms)"
FROM "ping_check"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "equipmentno" = '$device'
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT LAST("Power Status") AS "Power Status"
FROM "snmp_query"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "equipmentno" =~ /^$device$/

SELECT LAST("Firmware") AS "Firmware"
FROM "snmp_query"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "equipmentno" =~ /^$device$/

SELECT LAST("Lamp Hours") AS "Lamp Hours"
FROM "snmp_query"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "equipmentno" = '$device'

SELECT LAST("Uptime") AS "Uptime"
FROM "snmp_query"
WHERE $timeFilter AND "equipmentno" =~ /^$device$/

WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb AS (
  SELECT dp.position AS start_pos,
         p.equipmentno AS cur_pos,
         p.parentasset AS parent_pos,
         0 AS depth,
         ARRAY[p.equipmentno] AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.start_pos, p.equipmentno, p.parentasset, c.depth + 1, c.visited || p.equipmentno
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno = ANY (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
         c.start_pos,
         c.cur_pos AS room_no,
         c.depth
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
rooms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT room.equipmentno AS room_no
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_devices   d    ON d.position       = pr.start_pos      -- keeps “rooms that have devices”
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no        -- the room row
  WHERE (
    '${status:raw}' = '__all'
    OR room.assetstatus_display ~ ('^(' || '${status:regex}' || ')$')
  )
),
fmt AS (
  SELECT
    room_no AS __value,
    CONCAT(
      split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
      split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
      split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',3)
    ) AS __text,
    split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',1) AS p1,
    split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',2) AS p2,
    split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',3) AS p3
  FROM rooms
)
SELECT __value, __text
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(p1,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p1n, regexp_replace(p1,'^\d+','') AS p1s,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(p2,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p2n, regexp_replace(p2,'^\d+','') AS p2s,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(p3,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p3n, regexp_replace(p3,'^\d+','') AS p3s
  FROM fmt
) q
ORDER BY
  p1n NULLS LAST, p1s,
  p2n NULLS LAST, p2s,
  p3n NULLS LAST, p3s,
  __value;

WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (

  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),

  FROM climb c

  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT d.category
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_devices   d    ON d.position       = pr.start_pos
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  WHERE
    ( '${status:raw}' = '__all'
      OR room.assetstatus_display ~ ('^(' || '${status:regex}' || ')$') )   -- ← room-based status
    AND ( '${room:raw}' = '__all' OR pr.room_no ~ '${room:regex}' )
    AND ( '${eqclass:raw}' = '__all'
          OR d.eqclass = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY('${eqclass:csv}', ',')) )
),
mapped AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE f.category
      WHEN 'AV-PRO' THEN 'Projector'
      WHEN 'AV-PSC' THEN 'Projection Screen'
      WHEN 'AV-SCR' THEN 'LCD Screen'
      WHEN 'AV-WIR' THEN 'Wireless Display'
      WHEN 'AVC-AR' THEN 'Audio Recording'
      WHEN 'AVC-CO' THEN 'Control PC'
      WHEN 'AVC-EN' THEN 'Encoding PC'
      WHEN 'AVC-PR' THEN 'Presentation PC'
      WHEN 'AVC-SC' THEN 'Screen Control PC'
      ELSE f.category
    END AS __text,
    f.category AS __value
  FROM filtered f
  WHERE f.category IS NOT NULL AND f.category <> ''
)
SELECT __text, __value
FROM (
  SELECT __text, __value FROM mapped
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'None' AS __text, '__none__' AS __value
) x
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN __value = '__none__' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  __text;

SELECT
  d.equipmentno AS "__value",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(d.equipmentdesc, ''), '[' || d.equipmentno || ']') AS "__text"
FROM eam_devices d
WHERE d.equipmentno IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "__text";
